data.one_liner: Parse and generate CSV strings with stream support and Excel compatibility.
data.what_it_does: Provides functions and stream transformers to encode Dart lists to CSV and decode CSV strings back to Dart structures. Supports custom delimiters, Excel‑compatible output, auto‑detection, and optional dynamic typing.
use_when: Reading or writing CSV files, especially large ones via streams
Want automatic delimiter detection or dynamic typing
avoid_when: Working with binary or non‑textual data formats
Require strict schema validation or relational features
Need a full‑featured data storage solution
strengths: Configurable delimiters, quoting, and dynamic typing
High performance and low memory usage
weaknesses: Only handles CSV, no other data formats
No built‑in validation or schema enforcement
Limited to text processing; not a full data storage solution
